method: CLASSLA tokenize+pos+lemma on Cyrillic→Latin verse text; surface forms latin_to_cyrillic(word.text); keep UPOS=['ADJ', 'NOUN', 'PROPN', 'VERB']; drop function lemmas + most PROPN; min_frequency=2 (token occurrences across dk+spc)

pilot_stats.nz_scale_estimate_rough: ~1020 concepts in Mark; NT≈27 books but Mark is short — naive ×27≈27540, realistic ~3–6× Mark (3060–6120) after dedup across books

filter_notes.noise_level: Full concepts list (~1020) still contains narrative verbs (reći, doći…) needed for inventory; use review_shortlist for manual theological pass.
filter_notes.missing_in_mark_as_separate_lemmas: spasavati/spasenje/spas barely present as separate lemmas in Mark (mostly spasti); blagosiljati absent — only blagosloviti/blagosloven. Aspect splits clearer when scaling to full NZ.
filter_notes.dk_spc_diff: dk-only=54, spc-only=59 concepts (often dialect/lemma labeling differences, not always real lexical gaps)
